name: Dal Lake, Srinagar
title: DAL LAKE
description: Experience the magic of Kashmir's crown jewel — Dal Lake. Float on a traditional shikara through lotus gardens and floating vegetable markets, stay in a heritage houseboat, and wake up to the Himalayas reflected in still waters.

days.detail: Pickup from Srinagar Airport, check-in to houseboat on Dal Lake. Evening shikara ride on the lake. Welcome Kashmiri dinner on board.
Morning shikara ride through floating markets. Visit Nishat Bagh, Shalimar Bagh, and Chashme Shahi gardens. Evening free on the lake.
Visit Shankaracharya Temple, Hazratbal Shrine, and the old city bazaars. Explore Lal Chowk and local handicraft shops.
Optional cooking class, carpet weaving demonstration, or a relaxed morning on the houseboat. Afternoon at leisure.
Breakfast on the houseboat. Transfer to Srinagar Airport for your onward journey. Tour ends with warm memories.

name: Gulmarg
title: GULMARG
description: Nestled at 2,650 metres in the Pir Panjal range, Gulmarg — the 'Meadow of Flowers' — is Kashmir's premier hill resort. Famous for Asia's highest gondola ride, world-class skiing in winter, and lush green meadows in summer.

days.detail: Pickup from Srinagar, drive to Gulmarg (56 km). Check-in to hotel. Evening walk in the meadows. Overnight stay.
Morning Gondola ride to Kongdori (Phase 1 & 2). Trek to Alpather Lake. Enjoy snow activities (seasonal). Return to hotel.
Explore the Gulmarg Biosphere Reserve. Horse riding in the meadows. Visit St. Mary's Church and the golf course area.
Breakfast at hotel. Drive back to Srinagar. Airport/railway station drop. Tour ends.

name: Pahalgam
title: PAHALGAM
description: Known as the 'Valley of Shepherds', Pahalgam sits at the confluence of the Lidder River and streams from Sheshnag Lake. This enchanting destination offers pine forests, alpine meadows, and the famous Betaab Valley and Aru Valley.
destinations: SRINAGAR · PAHALGAM · BETAAB VALLEY · ARU VALLEY

days.detail: Pickup from Srinagar, scenic drive to Pahalgam (95 km) via Awantipora ruins. Check-in to hotel on the Lidder River bank.
Visit Betaab Valley, Chandanwari, and Aru Valley. Enjoy the meadows and river views.
Pony ride or trek to Baisaran (mini Switzerland of Kashmir). Afternoon river rafting on the Lidder (optional). Evening at leisure.
Breakfast at hotel. Drive back to Srinagar. Airport/station drop. Tour ends.

name: Sonamarg
title: SONAMARG
description: Sonamarg, the 'Meadow of Gold', is a high-altitude paradise at 2,800 metres on the Srinagar–Leh highway. Surrounded by glaciers, alpine lakes, and snow-capped peaks, it is the gateway to the famous Thajiwas Glacier.

days.detail: Pickup from Srinagar, drive to Sonamarg (87 km) through the scenic Sindh Valley. Check-in to hotel. Evening walk in the meadows.
Morning pony ride or trek to Thajiwas Glacier. Snow activities on the glacier. Optional trek towards Vishansar Lake. Return to hotel.
Breakfast at hotel. Scenic drive back to Srinagar. Airport/station drop. Tour ends.

name: Betaab Valley
title: BETAAB VALLEY
description: Named after the 1983 Bollywood blockbuster filmed here, Betaab Valley is one of Kashmir's most picturesque destinations. Located just 15 km from Pahalgam, this lush green valley is framed by snow-capped mountains and dense pine forests.

days.detail: Pickup from Srinagar, drive to Pahalgam. Check-in to hotel. Evening walk along the Lidder River.
Full day excursion to Betaab Valley and Chandanwari. Enjoy the meadows, river, and mountain views. Photography stops en route.
Breakfast at hotel. Drive back to Srinagar. Airport/station drop. Tour ends.

name: Tulip Garden, Srinagar
title: TULIP GARDEN
description: Asia's largest tulip garden, spread across 30 hectares on the foothills of the Zabarwan Range overlooking Dal Lake, bursts into a riot of colour every spring (March–April). Timed for the annual Tulip Festival.
destinations: SRINAGAR · TULIP GARDEN · DAL LAKE · MUGHAL GARDENS

days.detail: Pickup from airport. Check-in to houseboat on Dal Lake. Evening shikara ride. Welcome dinner.
Morning visit to the Indira Gandhi Memorial Tulip Garden. Afternoon at Nishat Bagh and Shalimar Bagh. Photography session.
Visit Shankaracharya Temple, Hazratbal Shrine, and Lal Chowk bazaars. Explore Kashmiri handicrafts and papier-mâché shops.
Visit Chashme Shahi (Royal Spring) and Pari Mahal (Palace of Fairies) with panoramic Dal Lake views. Leisure evening on the lake.
Breakfast on houseboat. Transfer to Srinagar Airport. Tour ends.

name: Yusmarg
title: YUSMARG
description: Yusmarg, meaning 'Meadow of Jesus', is an unspoiled alpine meadow 47 km from Srinagar, far from the tourist crowds. Surrounded by dense pine and fir forests, wildflower meadows, and the Doodhganga River.

days.detail: Pickup from Srinagar, drive to Yusmarg (47 km) through pine forests. Check-in to guesthouse. Evening walk in the meadows.
Morning trek to Nilnag Lake through alpine meadows. Picnic lunch in the meadows. Afternoon horse riding. Evening bonfire.
Breakfast at guesthouse. Drive back to Srinagar. Airport/station drop. Tour ends.

name: Wular Lake
title: WULAR LAKE
description: Wular Lake, Asia's largest freshwater lake, stretches across 200 sq km in the Bandipora district of Kashmir. A haven for migratory birds, local fishermen, and nature lovers seeking raw Himalayan beauty.
destinations: SRINAGAR · WULAR LAKE · MANASBAL LAKE · BANDIPORA

days.detail: Pickup from Srinagar, drive to Bandipora (60 km). Check-in to lakeside guesthouse. Evening boat ride on Wular Lake.
Morning boat trip to Zaina Lanka island. Visit local fishing villages. Birdwatching (migratory birds in season). Afternoon at leisure.
Day trip to Manasbal Lake (Kashmir's deepest lake). Visit Shadipur confluence of Jhelum and Sindh rivers. Return to guesthouse.
Breakfast at guesthouse. Drive back to Srinagar. Airport/station drop. Tour ends.

included: Boat rides on Wular & Manasbal lakes
